what: verification of the standing reference list in Hard_Zeta_Collatz_New_Chat_Handoff_v1.0.md section 25
checked_by: 數學戰士「墜衡」 / AMRAL Research Lab
why_this_list_is_different: Every previous literature check in this sweep read the notes attached to one round. This list is the standing bibliography a NEW conversation is instructed to work from, so an entry here is not a citation in one paper -- it is a starting assumption for every paper after.

references.title: The 3x+1 Problem: An Overview
references.verdict: accurate, and it is the only reference the handoff adds that no round document cites. A survey is a sensible thing for a bootstrap list to carry.

references.author: Tong Niu
references.title: Parity vectors and paradoxical sequences in the accelerated Collatz map
references.new_this_round: this occurrence is not a citation inside a round. It is an entry in the STANDING reference list a fresh conversation is told to work from, under the heading 常用文獻, with no note that the paper has been withdrawn. The four earlier occurrences propagated an unmarked withdrawal within the line; this one propagates it forward into work that has not been written yet.
references.the_list_does_annotate_elsewhere: the López–Stoll entry carries 「外部 criticality input，保留 caveat」 and the section ends with a warning against treating unaccepted Collatz proofs as fact, so the list's format supports caveats and this omission is a choice rather than a limitation

references.title: Paradoxical behavior in Collatz sequences
references.note: listed two lines below the withdrawn Niu entry, which is the paper Niu's withdrawal notice defers to

references.detail: RUN-029 found the A-U.2d.3 notes render the title as log_2 3 when the paper is titled log 3. The handoff repeats it, in the standing reference list. A citation defect confined to one round's notes is a footnote; the same defect in the bootstrap bibliography is inherited by every round that starts from it.
